summary.en: Recent Pakistani train derailments have killed four passengers and injured dozens in Multan and central Pakistan, while a separate blast near the LoC killed four men. Afghan Taliban fighters have been accused by Pakistan of using Afghan soil to launch cross-border attacks, and the Taliban have responded by accusing Pakistan of baseless allegations as clashes intensify. Pakistani security forces killed five terrorists in an intelligence-based operation in Washuk. The Taliban also claimed that natural disasters have killed 679 people. The conflict caused 1,794 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

background.title: Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
background.extract: Since 2004, an insurgency has been fought in the Pakistani province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa by Islamist militant groups such as the Tehrik-i-Taliban Pakistan (TTP), Jundallah, Lashkar-e-Islam (LeI), the Tehreek-e-Nafaz-e-Shariat-e-Mohammadi (TNSM), Al-Qaeda, and their Central Asian allies such as the Islamic State – Khorasan Province (ISKP), Islamic Movement of Uzbekistan, East Turkistan Movement, Jamaat-ul-Ahrar, Ittihad-ul-Mujahideen Pakistan, and elements of organised crime. Before being transformed into an insurgency in 2017, the conflict was a war.
